info.description:
Multi-tenant eSIM SDK + admin API. Three surfaces: SDK (/v1/sdk/*),
Webhooks (/v1/webhooks/*), Admin (/v1/admin/*), Partner (/v1/partner/*).
UUIDs encoded as JSON strings; monetary amounts as integer minor units paired with ISO-4217 codes.
info.title: eSIM API

post.description: Синтетический payments.captured через тот же путь, что и вебхук: платёж captured, заказ provisioning, выпуск у G-Engine за деньги кошелька. Разрешено в pending_payment и в failed (сессия истекла/упала), если покупатель не отменял заказ. Подарок заново занимает ключ «уже отправляется»; при конфликте 409 gift_in_progress и заказ остаётся неоплаченным. Пишет goods_order_audit confirm_payment.

Прямой вызов провайдера: реальный платный eSIM, без заказа/платежа, без сохранения. Каждый вызов — новый eSIM.

Tiles and section banners of the «Сервисы» home screen. Only entries that lead to something visible are returned (a tenant with goods turned off gets only its eSIM entries); an eSIM entry has target.type = esim and no id. A section tile may carry target.search_query: open that section with it as the search parameter of GET /v1/public/goods/sections/{id}/products.

Web cabinet additions (old apps ignore them): widget — the «Пополнение сервисов» tabs (form from GET /v1/public/goods/products/{product_id}); popular — the «Популярное» carousel, up to 20 cards shaped like the lists; sections[].filters — the section's chips {label, query}, a chip being its products list with search=query. All are always arrays, empty when goods are off.

post.description:
Validates and prices the purchase server-side (spec §5.1), checks the login with the supplier for top-ups, then opens the payment session. Open payment.url to pay.

Every response — including 409 price_changed and 422 errors — is cached under the Idempotency-Key; after fixing the input send a NEW key.

return_url (optional): where the PSP sends the payer after paying or failing — an absolute https URL of at most 512 characters under an operator-allowed prefix, at most one {order_id} (replaced by the order id). Absent: the storefront's own result pages.

parameters.name: body

403.description: goods_disabled — the tenant sells no goods

post.description: «Отменить заказ» in the waiting-for-payment sheet. Allowed only while can_cancel is true. Only while state = pending_payment; an already cancelled or expired order is returned as is. If the payment page is still paid afterwards, the order is fulfilled normally.

get.description:
Returns the authenticated user's orders newest-first with cursor pagination.

Каждая запись — это сокращённая проекция заказа без `payment` и `provision`. Значения `state` те же, что у `GET /v1/sdk/orders/{id}`: `pending_payment`, `paid`, `provisioning`, `delivered`, `failed`, `cancelled`. Поле `remaining` равно `null`, пока eSIM не выдан или usage-sync ещё не наблюдал трафик. `esim_status` — статус самой eSIM у провайдера (`issued` → `installed` → `activated` → `active` → `depleted` / `expired`), `null` до выдачи и до первого наблюдения; клиент должен терпеть неизвестные значения. Описание полной матрицы "какие поля null при каком статусе" см. в `GET /v1/sdk/orders/{id}`.

post.description:
Creates a single-item order for the given storefront plan and authorizes payment with the configured PSP.

На успехе возвращает заказ в стартовом `state == "pending_payment"` с `payment.state == "pending"`, заполненными `payment.url` и `payment.expires_at` — клиент SDK открывает `payment.url` для оплаты. Описание всех значений `state` и матрицу "какие поля null при каком статусе" см. в `GET /v1/sdk/orders/{id}`.

`return_url` (необязательно) — куда касса вернёт покупателя и после оплаты, и после отказа: абсолютный https-адрес до 512 символов с разрешённым оператором префиксом; `{order_id}` (не больше одного) заменяется на id заказа. Без него — страницы витрины.

parameters.description: Required idempotency token; replay returns the cached response
parameters.name: Idempotency-Key

400.description: invalid_body | validation_error | too_many_ids | invalid_id | invalid_return_url | missing_idempotency_key | invalid_idempotency_key

402.description: payment_declined — заказ сохранён, id в error.detail (order_id=<uuid>)

409.description: request_in_progress — параллельный запрос с тем же Idempotency-Key

post.description: Computes price totals for a cart of storefront plan ids. v1 expects exactly one id.

get.description:
Returns the full order envelope including delivery state. Cross-user access returns 404 (not 403) to disguise existence.

### Жизненный цикл `state` (поле `data.state`)

Соответствует CHECK-инварианту таблицы `orders` (migrations/00007):
* `pending_payment` — стартовое; ждём оплату от пользователя.
* `paid` — PSP подтвердил оплату webhook'ом `payments.captured`.
* `provisioning` — outbox-воркер пытается зарезервировать eSIM у провайдера (smcard).
* `delivered` — eSIM выдан; в `provision` лежат `iccid`, `activation_code`, `smdp_address`, `matching_id`, `qr_code_url`.
* `failed` — оплата отклонена/истекла, либо провижининг провалился окончательно (см. `payment.failure_code` / `provision.state`).
* `cancelled` — заказ отменён админом или прошёл возврат (`payment.state == "refunded"`).

### Какие поля заполнены / `null` на каком статусе

Обозначения: `+` — поле всегда присутствует и не `null`; `-` — поле равно `null` либо отсутствует в JSON; `?` — может присутствовать, см. примечания ниже.

| Поле                              | pending_payment | paid | provisioning | delivered | failed | cancelled |
|-----------------------------------|:---------------:|:----:|:------------:|:---------:|:------:|:---------:|
| `payment.state`                   | `pending` / `authorizing` | `captured` | `captured` | `captured` | `failed` | `captured` или `refunded` |
| `payment.url`                     | + (при `payment.state == "pending"`) | - | - | - | - | - |
| `payment.expires_at`              | + (вместе с `payment.url`) | - | - | - | - | - |
| `payment.failure_code`            | - | - | - | - | + | - |
| `provision`                       | `null` | `null` | ? (объект, `state` = `pending` / `requested`) | + (объект, `state == "delivered"`) | ? (если упало в провижининге — `state == "failed"`) | ? (если успели создать) |
| `provision.iccid`                 | - | - | - | + | - | - |
| `provision.activation_code`       | - | - | - | + | - | - |
| `provision.smdp_address`          | - | - | - | ? (когда LPA-строка well-formed) | - | - |
| `provision.matching_id`           | - | - | - | ? (когда LPA-строка well-formed) | - | - |
| `provision.qr_code_url`           | - | - | - | ? (при сбое presign S3 — пусто, ответ всё равно 200) | - | - |
| `provision.qr_code_url_expires`   | - | - | - | ? (вместе с `qr_code_url`) | - | - |
| `remaining`                       | `null` | `null` | `null` | ? (`null` до первого usage-sync, далее объект) | `null` | `null` |
| `esim_status`                     | `null` | `null` | `null` | ? (`issued` → `installed` → `activated` → `active` → `depleted` / `expired`; `null` до первого наблюдения) | `null` | ? |
| `activated_at`, `expires_at`      | `null` | `null` | `null` | ? (после первой регистрации eSIM в сети) | `null` | ? |
| `esim`, `tariff`, `items`         | + | + | + | + | + | + |
| `id`, `order_number`, `total_*`, `created_at` | + | + | + | + | + | + |

Примечания:
* `failed` достижим двумя путями. (1) Из `pending_payment` после `payments.failed` / `payments.expired` — `payment.failure_code` заполнен (`card_declined`, `provider_error`, `provider_failed`, `expired`), `provision` равен `null`. (2) Из `provisioning` после окончательного отказа провайдера — `payment.state == "captured"` без `failure_code`, `provision.state == "failed"`.
* `cancelled` достигается через админ-flow (`POST /v1/admin/orders/{id}/cancel`) или по webhook'у `payments.refunded`. Если переход случился после доставки eSIM, `provision` остаётся в JSON с прежним содержимым; `qr_code_url` всё равно пересоздаётся как 5-минутный presign на каждом запросе.
* На `delivered` `qr_code_url` и/или `activation_code` могут оказаться пустыми, если расшифровка LPA или presign S3 транзитно упали — handler намеренно отвечает 200 с частичным телом, SDK должен опросить заказ ещё раз.

404.description: order_not_found (включая случай, когда заказ принадлежит другому пользователю — намеренно отдаём 404, а не 403)

gift_refunded.description: GiftRefunded: G-Engine refunded the gift order; Retry buys again.

gift_upstream_unknown.description:
GiftUpstreamUnknown: the purchase outcome is unknown (ambiguous create
not found, or G-Engine 404) — Retry / new link / new region need
confirmed_absent («проверил в кабинете G-Engine: заказа нет»).

region.description: Gifts (spec gifts §4.4); zero values for other lines.

meta.description:
Meta carries machine-readable details for errors the client acts on
(e.g. amount_out_of_range → {min, max}). Omitted for every other error.

account.description: account: the login; steam_gift: the region name, never the recipient link

codes_unavailable.description: codes could not be decrypted: do not e-mail, escalate to an operator

external_user_id.description: empty for anonymized users: skip the e-mail

ttl_seconds.description:
Pointer so we can distinguish "absent" from an explicit zero. Absent
→ use service default; zero → service rejects with ErrTTLOutOfRange.

esim_status.description:
EsimStatus is the upstream eSIM lifecycle — what happened to the eSIM
after delivery, unlike Status (our issuance pipeline). Passed through
verbatim from the provider; clients must tolerate unknown values.
Omitted until observed. ActivatedAt/ExpiresAt appear once the eSIM
first attaches to the destination network. Delivered-only.

return_url.description:
ReturnURL (optional): where the PSP sends the payer after paying or
failing — an absolute https URL of at most 512 characters under one of
the operator's allowed prefixes, with at most one {order_id} (replaced
by the new order's id). Absent: the storefront's own result pages.

min_price_amount.description:
MinPriceAmount / MinPriceCurrency render the "from N" label on a
country row: the cheapest tariff that is purchasable right now. Both
are null together when the eSIM has none — clients treat that as "no
price to show", not as a free plan, so the fields are pointers and
carry no binding:"required".

MinPriceAmount is in MAJOR units (4550 minor → 45.5), matching
tariffDTO.PriceAmountMinor's existing — and misleadingly named —
convention. Keeping the two consistent matters more than fixing the
name, which is already load-bearing for shipped clients.

network.description:
Network is the operator and network line of the country (spec web
§7.5); null when the admin has not set one. Old apps ignore it.

photo_url.description:
PhotoURL is the scenic country photo (the catalogue card background and
the tariffs-screen header), as opposed to ImageURL's flag icon. It is a
pointer so an unset photo serializes as JSON null rather than "": the
client contract treats null/empty/absent alike, and null states "no
photo" without shipping a meaningless empty string to every client.

seo_title.description: SEO overrides for the country page; null = not set (the web derives them).

slug.description:
Slug is the readable page address of the country ("turtsiya"); it is
accepted wherever {id} is, and is what the web builds /services/esim/<slug> from.

hint.example: Логин для входа, не имя профиля

pattern.description:
Pattern: validate the field with this regexp before ordering (always
present on edition_region; on other forms only when the operator set one).

sticker.description:
Sticker: «Хит» (hit) / «Новинка» (new) on the card; null = none. The
app may ignore it (spec web §7.3).

popular.description:
Popular: the «Популярное» carousel, up to 20 cards shaped like the
lists. Always an array.

widget.description:
Widget: the «Пополнение сервисов» tabs; the tab's form is GET
/v1/public/goods/products/{product_id}. Always an array; the app may
ignore it (spec web §7.2).

filters.description:
Filters: the section's chips; a chip is GET
/v1/public/goods/sections/{id}/products?search=<query>. Always an
array (empty for most sections); the app may ignore it.

seo_title.description: SEO overrides for the section page; null = not set (the web derives them).

target.description: absent = opens this section's own list

web_image_url.description:
WebImageURL: the web cabinet's picture filling the whole tile; absent =
none (the web draws ImageURL on a pad). The app keeps ImageURL.

region.description:
Region: the recipient's Steam account region (edition_region only;
ignored for every other product).

return_url.description: ReturnURL (optional): same rules as on POST /v1/sdk/orders.

account.description:
Account: the login, or for steam_gift the masked recipient link (the
full link is never returned).

can_cancel.description:
CanCancel: show «Отменить заказ» (POST /v1/sdk/goods/orders/{id}/cancel).
Always present; old builds ignore it, new builds read absent as false.

delivery.description:
Delivery: code — codes in fulfillment.codes; account — credited to the
account, no code; steam_gift — sent as a Steam gift, no code (see gift).

delivery_eta.description:
DeliveryETA («Через 5–15 минут») and DeliveryNote (a line about the
delivery); null = not set.

section.description: Section: the product's section, for breadcrumbs (spec web §7.3).

seo_title.description: SEO overrides for the product page; null = not set (the web derives them).

flag.description: ISO-2, "eu" or "un"; the app draws flags

search_query.description:
SearchQuery (section tiles only): open the section with this text in
its search box, i.e. pass it as ?search= to the section products list.

slug.description:
Slug: slug of the product / section the target leads to (absent for
esim); usable in place of id in the product and section paths.

amount.description:
Amount (account_amount only): this variant's own limits; absent =
use form.amount.

prices.description:
Prices (edition_region only, instead of price): the regions this
edition is sold in.

qr_code_url_expires.description: RFC3339; null when qr_code_url is empty

esim_status.description:
EsimStatus is the provider-side eSIM lifecycle — what happened to the
eSIM after delivery (installed on the device? attached to the network?),
unlike State, which is our order pipeline. Passed through verbatim, so
SDK clients must tolerate values outside the enum. ActivatedAt /
ExpiresAt fill in once the eSIM first attaches to the destination
network (duration_days counts from ActivatedAt).
